title: CodeAtlas AI
summary: Repository onboarding and technical auditing in seconds instead of days — a Cerebras x Google Gemma hackathon build.
challenge: Cut repository onboarding and auditing from days to seconds by running a squad of specialists in parallel instead of one model reading the codebase in sequence.
decisions: Clone, parse and index once into a NetworkX knowledge graph that every agent shares
A planner agent dispatches the specialists, and each one returns structured JSON
The dashboard streams agent results live over server-sent events
Every analysis benchmarks Cerebras against a second provider on identical prompts

evidence.label: Build
evidence.value: Cerebras x Google DeepMind Gemma 4 hackathon

ownership: Designed and built the repository-audit flow end to end.

specimen.caption: Repo audit — tree, findings, module links

callouts.text: The repository is cloned, parsed and indexed once.
Findings arrive per specialist, each grounded in the shared knowledge graph.
Module links are read out of the graph the agents query by tool call.
Elapsed time for the run — which is the whole claim of the project.
